passages.note: House Final Reading vote on SB1457; Lieberman voted No as a State Representative, but the recorded vote alone does not show which of the bill's reason- and facility-based provisions he objected to.

passages.provision_quote: This act does not create or recognize a right to an abortion and does not make lawful an abortion that is currently unlawful.
passages.note: The enacted text bans sex-, race- and genetic-abnormality-selective abortions, restricts abortion at public educational facilities, and adds clinic, informed-consent and reporting rules; it sets no gestational limit.

rows.reasoning: SB 1457 (2021) bans abortions sought because of the child's sex, race or a genetic abnormality, restricts abortion at public educational facilities, and adds clinic, informed-consent and reporting rules; its own construction clause states it 'does not create or recognize a right to an abortion.' It sets no trimester-based limit and no exception rule, so it speaks to a dimension (reason and facility, not gestational stage) that this ladder does not order, matching the annex's narrow-restrictions hard case. Lieberman's recorded No vote as a State Representative on this bill therefore cannot establish any rung.
